en.headline: Very hot weather warning issued as temperatures climb
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the warning at 11:15 am, advising the public to guard against heat stroke while the city remains mainly fine and very hot.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Very Hot Weather Warning at 11:15 am on Monday, saying very hot weather was expected across Hong Kong.

The Observatory advised the public to beware of heat stroke, particularly elderly people, pregnant women, infants and children, those with chronic illnesses such as heart disease or high blood pressure, and the obese. People working outdoors or in high-temperature environments were urged to follow Labour Department guidance on heat prevention.

Temperatures at the Observatory reached 32 degrees Celsius by early afternoon, with some New Territories stations recording 34 to 35 degrees. The UV index was very high. The public was reminded to drink more water, avoid prolonged sun exposure and seek shade or cooler places if feeling unwell.

zh.headline: 天文台發出酷熱天氣警告
zh.dek: 天文台上午11時15分發出酷熱天氣警告，預料今日天氣酷熱，市民應慎防中暑。
body: 香港天文台周一上午11時15分發出酷熱天氣警告，表示預料本港天氣酷熱。
天文台提醒市民慎防中暑，長者、孕婦、嬰兒及小童、患有心臟病或高血壓等慢性病人士，以及過胖人士較易受影響。在炎熱天氣或高溫環境工作的人士，應參照勞工處的預防中暑指引採取防暑措施。
下午初段天文台氣溫錄得32度，新界部分地區達34至35度，紫外線指數屬甚高水平。市民應多補充水分，避免長時間在陽光下曝曬，如感不適應盡快到陰涼處休息。
